name: Louis Howard
source:
The successor to the first throne, with a position and good looks that everyone envy.
He often has a sad expression on his face.
Once upon a time, he was adopted by the Duke's family, who was not blessed with children, and became a tracer.

[Taken from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/100puri/chara/100louis_howard.html]official website[/url]]
